enumeration_method.arity: No binary restriction or upper arity cutoff.
enumeration_method.coefficient: old: 1; fresh at depth h with n children: (h-n*(h+1))/L
enumeration_method.constraints: Exact common-prefix lengths with anchor and every earlier color only.
enumeration_method.fresh_candidates: Every internal vertex of the full current tree, including unary vertices.
enumeration_method.integer_accumulation: Every step has denominator L; old steps have numerator L.
enumeration_method.old_candidates: Every individually labeled unused old leaf except the protected anchor.
enumeration_method.protection: Every fresh leaf is immediately protected and never an old candidate.
enumeration_method.retained_skeleton: All labeled old full paths plus marked first-II prefix through e.
enumeration_method.skeleton_comparison: Canonical unordered children; all depths and unary vertices retained.

limitations: These are finitely many exact experiments, not a universal proof.
No independent Reviewer acceptance is asserted.
Retained labeled skeleton isomorphism is checked, not a probability theorem.
No claim is made about sampled values, kernels, projection errors, or limits.
One canonical fresh-child name represents each extension choice.
